name: Warm Bread Pudding with Blueberry Compote & Vanilla Ice Cream

instructions.primary_message: Cut buns into 1-inch cubes, transfer to a large baking sheet pan, and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until bread is dry but not toasted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, grease 6 muffin cups with a thick layer of butter; set aside.
Place eggs, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, nutmeg, and cinnamon in a medium bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
177 ml whole milk
177 ml heavy cream
⅓ cup granulated sugar
¾ tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp nutmeg, ground
3 pinch cinnamon

instructions.primary_message: Once the bread cubes have cooled, transfer to the bowl with the egg mixture. Using a silicone spatula, gently stir to combine, making sure all of the bread is submerged. Set aside for 10 minutes to soak.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the blueberries.

Combine blueberries, maple syrup, and butter in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until blueberries soften and release their juices, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside while you finish the bread pudding.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup pure maple syrup
2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Spoon soaked bread into the prepared muffin cups, creating a mound of bread in the center of each cup. Divide remaining egg mixture between the cups, filling each to the rim.

Carefully place the muffin pan in the oven. Cook, rotating the pan halfway through baking, until bread puddings puff up to double their size, and custard is set, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Slide a knife down and around the side of each pudding to loosen. Holding the muffin pan over a baking sheet pan, carefully invert, and tap the pan to loosen the puddings.
To serve, divide blueberry sauce, bread pudding, and ice cream between bowls. Enjoy!

cooking_tip: Once the bread pudding is prepared, it will need 35 minutes to bake and cool. Allow 1 hour 15 minutes to complete this recipe.
